variants.name: Dust-coated station array
variants.depiction: Exact same four-leaf station array, broad steel feet, connector and controller as the clean original; an opaque ochre dust film obscures most blue photovoltaic cells and settled grit gathers along lower frame.
variants.distinction: Physical dust coating, not new panels or bent damage; identical geometry.

variants.name: Low-sided potato bed with tall stems
variants.depiction: Exact original low dark-skirted potato bay, now with taller potato stems and broad compound leaves spreading above low collar; medium reaches old rim but no extension fitted.
variants.distinction: Growth makes need for taller collar visible; keep original low skirt.

variants.name: Unsupported soybean row with filling pods
variants.depiction: Exact original long soybean trough, now mature slender stems sagging under hanging green pods, no trellis or mesh support.
variants.distinction: Mature pods and bowed stems, not supported final row.

variants.name: Lettuce tray with broad harvestable leaves
variants.depiction: Exact original shallow lettuce tray with cloth wick dipping into reservoir; broad ruffled crisp green outer leaves around small living centre, no uprooted plant.
variants.distinction: Mature living lettuce before picking; same shallow wicking tray.
